moto/win_event.description: A motorcyclist riding along the roadside loses control and swerves sharply into vegetation, causing the motorcycle to tip over.

moto/win_normal02.description: A dark SUV approaches on an elevated road, while a white car drives away below. Both vehicles maintain their lanes without sudden movements or collisions.

moto/win_normal05.description: A white SUV drives away on a narrow road, passing a stone wall and trees. It continues straight without sudden movements or hazards.

carla_v16/win_event.description: A person in a green top and pink skirt walks across the road from right to left, moving away from the bus stop area.

carla_v16/win_normal12.description: The dark SUV in the center lane maintains its position and direction of travel across all frames, staying within its lane without any sudden movements or deviations.

carla_v16/win_normal28.description: The dark sedan ahead maintains its lane and speed, while a blue car in the opposite lane remains steady. No sudden movements, swerves, or collisions occur.

carla_v16/win_normal42.description: A black car drives straight ahead in the center lane. Other vehicles remain stationary on the left and right sides of the road.

carla_v17/win_event.description: A black SUV drives toward and past the camera car on the left side of the road. A white bus remains stationary ahead in the right lane.

carla_v17/win_normal12.description: A dark blue SUV crosses the intersection from left to right in front of the camera car, moving away into the distance.

carla_v17/win_normal28.description: The silver convertible remains stationary in the center lane throughout all frames. A red vehicle is visible further ahead and appears to be moving forward slowly, maintaining its position relative to the road.

carla_v17/win_normal42.description: The silver car remains stationary in the center lane throughout all frames. No other road users enter its path, cross it, or exhibit any sudden movements.

carla_v18/win_event.description: A pedestrian runs from the sidewalk into the road, crossing directly in front of the camera car.

carla_v18/win_normal12.description: A red SUV and black convertible are parked on the right side of the road. The camera car moves forward, passing them without incident.

carla_v18/win_normal28.description: The green car maintains its lane while pedestrians walk along the sidewalk and cross at a designated area.

carla_v18/win_normal42.description: A person in red pants walks across the sidewalk from left to right. A second person in a green top walks away from the camera along the same path.
